# From any state satisfying the invariant, src.run refines spec.run.
def trace_from(~A: Data, ~cmp: A -> A -> Cmp, ~o: O.Order(~A, ~cmp), +ops: List<&2, E.Op<A>>, +d0: H.Heap<A>, +g0: {HS.inv(~A, ~cmp, d0) == True{} : Bool}) -> {view(~A, ~cmp, ~o, H.run(~A, ~cmp, ops, d0)) == S.run(~A, ~cmp, ops, HS.abs(~A, ~cmp, d0)) : List<&2, A> & List<&2, E.Obs<A>>}:
  +m0 = HS.abs(~A, ~cmp, d0)
  -P1 = {H.run_acc(~A, ~cmp, ops, (d0, Nil{})) == (fin(~A, ~cmp, ~o, ops, d0, Nil{}), List.reverse.go(&2, E.Obs<A>, srun_obs(~A, ~cmp, ~o, ops, m0), Nil{})) : H.Heap<A> & List<&2, E.Obs<A>>}
  -P2 = {HS.abs(~A, ~cmp, fin(~A, ~cmp, ~o, ops, d0, Nil{})) == srun_state(~A, ~cmp, ~o, ops, m0) : List<&2, A>}
  -P3 = {HS.inv(~A, ~cmp, fin(~A, ~cmp, ~o, ops, d0, Nil{})) == True{} : Bool}
  %Equal.sym(H.Heap<A> & List<&2, E.Obs<A>>, H.run_acc(~A, ~cmp, ops, (d0, Nil{})), (fin(~A, ~cmp, ~o, ops, d0, Nil{}), List.reverse.go(&2, E.Obs<A>, srun_obs(~A, ~cmp, ~o, ops, m0), Nil{})), Pair.fst(P1, P2 & P3, run_ok(~A, ~cmp, ~o, ops, d0, Nil{}, g0))) : {view(~A, ~cmp, ~o, H.finish(A, _)) == S.run(~A, ~cmp, ops, m0) : List<&2, A> & List<&2, E.Obs<A>>}
  %Equal.sym(List<&2, E.Obs<A>>, List.reverse(&2, E.Obs<A>, List.reverse.go(&2, E.Obs<A>, srun_obs(~A, ~cmp, ~o, ops, m0), Nil{})), srun_obs(~A, ~cmp, ~o, ops, m0), LL.rev_rev(E.Obs<A>, srun_obs(~A, ~cmp, ~o, ops, m0))) : {(HS.abs(~A, ~cmp, fin(~A, ~cmp, ~o, ops, d0, Nil{})), _) == S.run(~A, ~cmp, ops, m0) : List<&2, A> & List<&2, E.Obs<A>>}
  %Equal.sym(List<&2, A>, HS.abs(~A, ~cmp, fin(~A, ~cmp, ~o, ops, d0, Nil{})), srun_state(~A, ~cmp, ~o, ops, m0), Pair.fst(P2, P3, Pair.snd(P1, P2 & P3, run_ok(~A, ~cmp, ~o, ops, d0, Nil{}, g0)))) : {(_, srun_obs(~A, ~cmp, ~o, ops, m0)) == S.run(~A, ~cmp, ops, m0) : List<&2, A> & List<&2, E.Obs<A>>}
  Equal.sym(List<&2, A> & List<&2, E.Obs<A>>, S.run(~A, ~cmp, ops, m0), (srun_state(~A, ~cmp, ~o, ops, m0), srun_obs(~A, ~cmp, ~o, ops, m0)), L.pair_eta(List<&2, A>, List<&2, E.Obs<A>>, S.run(~A, ~cmp, ops, m0)))

def inv_from(~A: Data, ~cmp: A -> A -> Cmp, ~o: O.Order(~A, ~cmp), +ops: List<&2, E.Op<A>>, +d0: H.Heap<A>, +g0: {HS.inv(~A, ~cmp, d0) == True{} : Bool}) -> {HS.inv(~A, ~cmp, Pair.fst(H.Heap<A>, List<&2, E.Obs<A>>, H.run(~A, ~cmp, ops, d0))) == True{} : Bool}:
  +m0 = HS.abs(~A, ~cmp, d0)
  -P1 = {H.run_acc(~A, ~cmp, ops, (d0, Nil{})) == (fin(~A, ~cmp, ~o, ops, d0, Nil{}), List.reverse.go(&2, E.Obs<A>, srun_obs(~A, ~cmp, ~o, ops, m0), Nil{})) : H.Heap<A> & List<&2, E.Obs<A>>}
  -P2 = {HS.abs(~A, ~cmp, fin(~A, ~cmp, ~o, ops, d0, Nil{})) == srun_state(~A, ~cmp, ~o, ops, m0) : List<&2, A>}
  -P3 = {HS.inv(~A, ~cmp, fin(~A, ~cmp, ~o, ops, d0, Nil{})) == True{} : Bool}
  %Equal.sym(H.Heap<A> & List<&2, E.Obs<A>>, H.run_acc(~A, ~cmp, ops, (d0, Nil{})), (fin(~A, ~cmp, ~o, ops, d0, Nil{}), List.reverse.go(&2, E.Obs<A>, srun_obs(~A, ~cmp, ~o, ops, m0), Nil{})), Pair.fst(P1, P2 & P3, run_ok(~A, ~cmp, ~o, ops, d0, Nil{}, g0))) : {HS.inv(~A, ~cmp, Pair.fst(H.Heap<A>, List<&2, E.Obs<A>>, H.finish(A, _))) == True{} : Bool}
  Pair.snd(P2, P3, Pair.snd(P1, P2 & P3, run_ok(~A, ~cmp, ~o, ops, d0, Nil{}, g0)))
